profile.description: GSA administrator responsible for federal procurement agreements with AI providers.

summary.text: In October 2025 congressional testimony, Edward Forst said GSA must lead government technology transformation and that the administration prioritized responsible and accelerated AI adoption, citing OneGov and USAi for secure AI tools while emphasizing data privacy. In 2026 statements as GSA administrator, Forst linked OneGov agreements with OpenAI and Snowflake to expanding agency AI adoption and cross-agency data capabilities under the White House AI Action Plan. Forst also said GSA stands with President Trump on a national security AI directive and that building resilient, secure, and scalable AI requires alignment and trust.
